cells.label: fact
cells.reason: The passages directly describe the workplace channel and its pipeline into wealth management.

items.text: Morgan Stanley defines the workplace channel as including equity compensation solutions for companies, their executives and employees.
items.quote: The workplace channel includes equity compensation solutions for companies, their executives and employees.
items.definition: equity compensation solutions for companies, their executives and employees

items.text: Morgan Stanley defines stock plan participants as total accounts with vested and/or unvested stock plan assets in the workplace channel, with individuals holding accounts in multiple plans counted in each plan.
items.quote: Stock plan participants represent total accounts with vested and/or unvested stock plan assets in the workplace channel. Individuals with accounts in multiple plans are counted as participants in each plan.
items.definition: total accounts with vested and/or unvested stock plan assets in the workplace channel

items.text: The CFO described the workplace channel as a powerful asset acquisition tool, with the reopening of the IPO market supporting net new assets.
items.quote: The reopening of the IPO market also supported results, further evidence that our workplace channel serves as a powerful asset acquisition tool.

items.text: The CFO said Workplace brings relationships and assets onto the platform and is a strong contributor to the top of the funnel, with stock plan IPO flows representing just over half of overall net new assets in the quarter.
items.quote: Workplace brings relationships and assets onto the platform... Stock plan IPO flows represented just over half of the overall NNA this quarter... illustrating the strength of the workplace channel as a strong contributor to the top of the funnel.

items.text: The CEO said the financial advisors, Workplace, and E*TRADE channels together comprise the firm's strategic client acquisition model.
items.quote: Our financial advisors, Workplace, and E*TRADE, each a category leader, which taken together comprise our strategic client acquisition model.

items.text: Advisor-led assets originating from workplace and E*TRADE relationships grew to a record $99 billion for the full year 2025, versus historical averages of around $60 billion per year.
items.quote: Advisor-led assets originating from workplace and E*TRADE relationships accelerated, growing to a record $99 billion for the full year, compared to historical averages of around $60 billion per year.
items.definition: Advisor-led assets originating from workplace and E*TRADE relationships

items.text: In the first quarter of 2025, assets migrating to the advisor-led channel that originated from the workplace channel increased by an incremental $20 billion, adding to roughly $300 billion accumulated from workplace since the channel expanded in 2020.
items.quote: assets migrating to the advisor-led channel that originated from the workplace channel as these relationships grow, with an incremental $20 billion this quarter, adding to the roughly $300 billion accumulated from workplace since we expanded our channel in 2020.
items.definition: assets migrating to the advisor-led channel that originated from the workplace channel

items.text: The firm said it has about 70% of the top 100 unicorns by market cap in its workplace pipeline, with IPOs serving as a source of net new assets at the top of the funnel.
items.quote: we have about 70% of the top 100 unicorns by market cap in terms of our workplace pipeline... IPOs can serve as a form of where we get NNA and the top of the funnel.
items.unit: of top 100 unicorns by market cap in workplace pipeline

items.text: The CFO said 70% of the flows that originate from the workplace channel are actually net new assets to the firm.
items.quote: 70% of the flows that come from workplace, that originate from workplace, is actually net new assets to the firm.
items.unit: of workplace-originated flows that are net new assets

items.text: The CFO said the firm is working on a referral model that can begin as early as the financial education spot to convert workplace clients into advice-based (advisor-led) relationships.
items.quote: for those that might not yet have the advice-based relationship, we're working on that referral model. And that's something that can begin as early as the financial education spot.

items.text: The CEO said the Morgan Stanley at Work business positions the firm as an early trusted advisor to over 50,000 private companies, with employees benefiting from management of equity compensation plans, liquidity opportunities, and full-service advice.
items.quote: Our Morgan Stanley at Work business, with its exclusive partnership with Carta, positions us as an early trusted advisor to over 50,000 private companies... Employees across our workplace companies benefit from our management of equity compensation plans, liquidity opportunities, and our full-service advice.

items.text: The CFO said the firm historically had about $16 billion per year originating from workplace, and was running ahead of that in 2025.
items.quote: We used to say we had about $16 billion per year that were originating from workplace. This year, we're running ahead of those numbers.

items.text: The CFO said workplace has been a contributor to net new assets, fee-based flows, and channel migration, citing a $300 billion workplace migration figure and about $60 billion of migration per year historically.
items.quote: Historically, we've asked about, we've given a $300 billion number about that workplace migration, and we've said that we've seen about $60 billion of migration per year... Workplace has been a contributor to net new assets, to fee-based flows, and channel migration.
items.unit: USD per year of workplace migration

items.text: The strategic update deck showed advisor-led flows from workplace and E*TRADE of approximately $60 billion average for 2020-2024 and approximately $100 billion for 2025.
items.quote: Advisor-Led Flows from Workplace and E*TRADE ($Bn)... ~60 ... Avg. 2020 - 2024 ... ~100 ... 2025
items.unit: USD (billions) advisor-led flows from workplace and E*TRADE
items.definition: Advisor-Led Flows from Workplace and E*TRADE represent assets brought into advisor-led relationships, where the initial account was workplace or self-directed.

items.text: The CEO described the attachment points that bring clients to E*TRADE and, where appropriate, fee-based flows that make their way to advisers, with clients acquired in the corporate stock plan (workplace) context.
items.quote: we are very excited about the attachment points ultimately that bring clients to E*TRADE, that we are close with them in the corporate stock plan context, i.e., workplace, but then ultimately, where it's appropriate, fee-based flows that make their way to the advisers.

items.text: The CFO said the firm's pipeline and connectivity across channels allows it to build relationships early and deepen them over time.
items.quote: our pipeline and our connectivity across channels allows us to build relationships early and deepen them over time.
